title: Zero forcing and path number under vertex sums
statement:
Let $G$ and $H$ be graphs with an identified vertex $v$. Write $G\,\makebox[0ex][l]{$+$} \raisebox{-.75ex}{\makebox[2ex]{$_{v}$}}\,H$ for their vertex sum at $v$. Suppose that $Z(G)=P(G)$ and $Z(H)=P(H)$. **Vertex-sum conjecture.** Then

$$
Z(G\,\makebox[0ex][l]{$+$} \raisebox{-.75ex}{\makebox[2ex]{$_{v}$}}\,H)=P(G\,\makebox[0ex][l]{$+$} \raisebox{-.75ex}{\makebox[2ex]{$_{v}$}}\,H).
$$

This proposed closure property would provide a larger family of graphs for which the zero forcing number equals the path number, extending the known examples of block-cycle graphs. The source presents it as a problem for further study; its resolution is not given here.
source_name: Fatemeh Alinaghipour Taklimi, Shaun Fallat and Karen Meagher, “On the Relationships between Zero Forcing Numbers and Certain Graph Coverings”, arXiv:1311.7064 (2013).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1311.7064

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2013).
